title: Sing To The Lord A New Song

request.style: English, soulful female voice, electric guitar, upright bass, piano, drums, organ, melancholic and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sing to the LORD a new song
Call out to all the earth
Sing to the LORD and bless his name
His salvation is so dear

[Chorus]
Proclaim his salvation day after day
Declare his glory among the nations
His wonders shown to all peoples
Great is the LORD in praise

[Verse]
He is to be feared above all gods
For all the gods of the peoples
Are idols and nothing more
But the LORD made the heavens

[Chorus]
Proclaim his salvation day after day
Declare his glory among the nations
His wonders shown to all peoples
Great is the LORD in praise

[Outro]
Splendor and majesty before him
Strength and beauty in his sanctuary
